Completion on the user track after 2 min fine-tune
rows.note: 120 s of training, 24 PPO updates + 96 DAgger batches (3 per PPO update, PPO first), probes (user/held-out procedural) 16s:100%/100% 32s:100%/100% 49s:100%/100% 61s:100%/100% 78s:100%/100% 90s:100%/100% 108s:100%/100% 120s:100%/100%. Adaptation is imitation of the pure-pursuit baseline (DAgger on the user track and the replay pool) interleaved with PPO. The attribution below splits imitation from PPO. Attribution, same starting weights, 120 s of training each (zero-shot 100%): imitation only: user 100% at the end, >= 80% 15 s, lowest user probe 100%, held-out procedural 100% at the end and 100% at worst; PPO only: user 100% at the end, >= 80% 17 s, lowest user probe 100%, held-out procedural 100% at the end and 100% at worst; combined (shipped): user 100% at the end, >= 80% 16 s, lowest user probe 100%, held-out procedural 100% at the end and 100% at worst. The base already drove this track, so there is no improvement to attribute.
